topic: Protein a school lunch should supply, age 6 to 7
claim_a: 15.3 to 31.4 g: 30 to 40% of 1,570 kcal at 13 to 20% of energy from protein (Decision 3958 rule, APR-04; our calculation)
claim_b: 9.6 to 12.8 g: 30 to 40% of the 32 g a day in the NIN 2026 lookup (NQR-01)
position_taken: Use the RNI share for adequacy and note that the energy-share rule makes software menus protein-heavy
notes: Explains why published lunches carry 31.8 g (PMR-26).

claim_a: A soybean school meal added 0.5 cm in 8 months in Bangladesh (NQR-27); school milk improved height-for-age in rural Vietnam (NQR-25)
claim_b: Daily milk and egg for two years did not change height in rural China (NQR-26)
position_taken: Treat height gains at school age as small and uncertain; the stronger designs show none
notes: NQR-27 had two clusters; NQR-25 allocation not stated in the abstract.

claim_b: Human ileal digestibility in children about 20% lower (SCI-42)
position_taken: Use 69 to 86 (our calculation for the low end)
notes: Already logged in the package as DG-110; restated for this table.

topic: Zinc and iron values in the 2026 recommended intakes
claim_a: Decision 3958 cites the 2016 RNI for zinc and iron by age (APR-04)
claim_b: The NIN online lookup, updated in March 2026 after Decision 116/QD-VDD, shows identical zinc and iron values (NQR-01)
position_taken: Treat the values as current until Decision 116 is read
notes: Either the 2026 revision kept them or the lookup mixes versions.
